properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued July 25 at 11:29AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Coastal waters from Cape Fear NC to Little River Inlet SC out 20
NM...
Coastal waters from Surf City to Cape Fear NC out 20 nm...
Waters from Surf City NC to Little River Inlet SC from 20 to 60
NM...

At 1126 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated strong thunderstorms near
the waters off Bald Head island, capable of producing winds to
around 30 knots and frequent lightning. This thunderstorm was
located over Bald Head Island, moving northeast at 25 knots.
Additional thunderstorms are expected to impact the waters over the
next several hours. Be alert for rapidly changing conditions.

Locations impacted include...
Fort Fisher, 10 Mile Boxcars, Liberty Ship, Dallas Rock, Billy
Murrell Reef, Johnny Mercer Pier, Masonboro Sea Buoy, Harris Reef, 10
Mile Rocks, Kure Beach Point, School House Reef, Sheepshead Rock,
Buoy Off Carolina Beach, Wr2, Dredge Wreck, 5 Mile Boxcars, Kure
Beach, Caswell Beach, North Masonboro Island, and Wrightsville Beach.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until this storm passes. If caught on the open water,
prepare for deteriorating conditions. Make sure you and your crew are
wearing properly fitted life jackets.
properties.area: Coastal waters from Surf City to Cape Fear NC out 20 nm; Coastal waters from Cape Fear NC to Little River Inlet SC out 20 NM; Waters from Surf City NC to Little River Inlet SC from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 25 at 11:16AM EDT until July 25 at 12:15PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
S of Ocracoke Inlet NC to Cape Lookout NC out to 20 NM...
Waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Cape Lookout NC from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1215 PM EDT.

* At 1116 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Atlas Tanker, moving east at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
properties.area: S of Ocracoke Inlet NC to Cape Lookout NC out to 20 NM; Waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Cape Lookout NC from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued July 25 at 11:12AM EDT until July 25 at 2:15PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
FFWILM

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Bladen County in southeastern North Carolina...
Northern Columbus County in southeastern North Carolina...

* Until 215 PM EDT.

* At 1112 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated numerous showers and
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of
1 to 3 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Whiteville, Chadbourn, Lake Waccamaw, Sandyfield, Hallsboro,
Emerson, Elkton, Redbug, Council, Southeastern Community College,
Carvers, Kelly, Evergreen, Bolton, East Arcadia, and Cerro Gordo.
properties.instruction:
Flash flooding from heavy rainfall can be expected, especially near
poor drainage areas and other flood prone locations. Roads may be
damaged or washed away. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles. If
flooding is observed, then turn around, don't drown.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 25 at 8:34AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Nueces River near Three Rivers.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 40.0 feet, Significant flooding reaches miles from the
main channel, flooding homes in the flood plain near Three Rivers
to Lake Corpus Christi. Up to 4 feet of water is in River Creek
Acres Subdivision, flooding several homes. Kellner Camp along
County Road 336 floods, with water several feet deep surrounding
homes. Antelope Lane is flooded cutting off access to J.I. Hailey
Subdivision at Jones River bend. Water approaches the base of homes
along the river in Buckeye Knoll Subdivision, 2 miles west of
Swinny Switch.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:15 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 1.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
Tuesday morning and continue rising to 40.4 feet Thursday
morning. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 40.6
feet on 07/11/2007.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.
